scoring.purpose: Paper-to-ARK relevance only; not scientific quality, author merit, venue prestige, or general importance.

P1.label: Core relevance
P1.description: Directly informs a current ARK research question, benchmark, or safety mechanism.

P2.label: Supporting relevance
P2.description: Provides useful methods, evaluation approaches, or adjacent evidence.

P3.label: Exploratory relevance
P3.description: Useful context or possible future direction with a less direct connection to the current roadmap.

scoring.policy: Current tiers are provisional editorial triage, not computed or validated scores. Numeric scores are withheld until a reviewer records criterion-level evidence and rationale. P3 never means useless or low quality.

papers.title: Concrete Problems in AI Safety
papers.rationale: Foundational taxonomy of reward hacking, side effects, scalable supervision, safe exploration, and distribution shift.

papers.title: AI Safety Gridworlds
papers.rationale: Direct precedent for controlled, reproducible environments testing interruptibility, reward gaming, side effects, and robustness.

papers.title: Goal Misgeneralization: Why Correct Specifications Aren't Enough For Correct Goals
papers.rationale: Directly informs tests of objective misgeneralization under distribution shifts and changed environments.

papers.title: Risks from Learned Optimization in Advanced Machine Learning Systems
papers.rationale: Provides the mesa-optimization and inner-alignment framework for future learned-agent and self-improvement threat models.

papers.title: Defining and Characterizing Reward Gaming
papers.rationale: Formalizes reward gaming and the relationship between proxy reward and true task performance; directly informs ARK reward-conflict experiments.

papers.title: Sycophancy to Subterfuge: Investigating Reward-Tampering in Large Language Models
papers.rationale: Studies generalization from simple specification gaming to reward tampering; closely matches ARK's reward-integrity threat model.

papers.title: The Off-Switch Game
papers.rationale: Formal model of incentives around human shutdown and intervention; directly informs ARK corrigibility probes.

papers.title: AI safety via debate
papers.rationale: A proposal for scalable oversight and human evaluation; useful for future oversight experiments, with practical limitations to test.

papers.title: Not what you've signed up for: Compromising Real-World LLM-Integrated Applications with Indirect Prompt Injection
papers.rationale: Foundational threat model for malicious instructions embedded in retrieved content and tool-integrated applications.

papers.title: InjecAgent: Benchmarking Indirect Prompt Injections in Tool-Integrated Large Language Model Agents
papers.rationale: Provides a reproducible tool-agent prompt-injection benchmark with attack cases and evaluation methodology.

papers.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
papers.rationale: Relevant to episodic memory and feedback-driven agent adaptation; useful for testing whether reflection improves or destabilizes goal adherence.

papers.title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
papers.rationale: A clear generate–critique–revise loop for studying feedback reliability, self-evaluation errors, and iterative agent behaviour.

papers.title: Automatic Prompt Optimization with “Gradient Descent” and Beam Search
papers.rationale: Methodological reference for prompt optimization using textual feedback, search, and measurable task outcomes.

papers.title: Large Language Models as Optimizers
papers.rationale: Useful baseline for iterative LLM optimization from prior candidates and scores; supports bounded self-improvement experiments.

papers.title: Promptbreeder: Self-Referential Self-Improvement via Prompt Evolution
papers.rationale: Studies self-referential prompt evolution and is relevant to ARK's bounded self-modification and optimization threat models.

papers.title: InstructZero: Efficient Instruction Optimization for Black-Box Large Language Models
papers.rationale: Useful comparison for black-box instruction optimization and evaluating whether optimized prompts preserve safety constraints.

papers.title: DSPy: Compiling Declarative Language Model Calls into Self-Improving Pipelines
papers.rationale: Engineering framework for compiling and optimizing LM pipelines against metrics; relevant to reproducible agent evaluation and bounded optimization.

papers.title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning
papers.rationale: Current reflective optimization method; useful for designing tests of trajectory-based feedback, prompt updates, and optimization safety.

papers.title: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents
papers.rationale: Broad interactive benchmark and failure-analysis reference for agent reasoning, decision-making, and instruction following.

papers.title: GAIA: a benchmark for General AI Assistants
papers.venue: arXiv preprint; subsequently presented as an ICLR benchmark
papers.rationale: Useful for general assistant capability, tool-use, and multi-step task evaluation, though not a dedicated safety benchmark.

papers.title: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
papers.rationale: Provides realistic computer-use environments and execution-based evaluation for future tool-using ARK agents.

papers.title: AGENTSAFE: Benchmarking the Safety of Embodied Agents on Hazardous Instructions
papers.rationale: Evaluates perception, planning, and execution failures in embodied agents; strongly relevant to ARK's planned robotics-simulation phase.

papers.title: From Untrusted Input to Trusted Memory: A Systematic Study of Memory Poisoning Attacks in LLM Agents
papers.rationale: Directly studies persistent memory write channels, attack classes, and benchmark design matching ARK's memory-corruption module.

papers.title: Hidden in Memory: Sleeper Memory Poisoning in LLM Agents
papers.publication_status: Preprint; conference submission status not independently confirmed
papers.rationale: Studies delayed poisoning across sessions, a close match for ARK's persistent-memory threat tests.

papers.title: MemPoison: Uncovering Persistent Memory Threats and Structural Blind Spots in LLM Agents
papers.rationale: Provides a multi-type memory-poisoning benchmark and analyzes blind spots in write-time defenses.

papers.title: Specification gaming: the flip side of AI ingenuity
papers.rationale: Accessible examples useful for orientation; this is a blog resource, not a peer-reviewed paper.

papers.title: Same Score, Different Evidence: Decodability, Surface Sufficiency, and Causal Relevance in Code Models
papers.venue: NeurIPS 2026 Interpretability as a Science workshop — claimed on a project page; not independently confirmed
papers.publication_status: Candidate record — verify acceptance and final attribution
papers.rationale: Highly relevant methodology for separating decodability, surface-feature shortcuts, and causal evidence; priority reflects topical fit only.
